links.outcome: Accuracy, safety, and guideline concordance of LLM hypertension management recommendations versus expert
links.effect: GPT-4 accuracy 83%, safety 86% vs expert 92%/93%; Gemini 64%/73%; MedLM 35%/39%. Guideline-concordant: GPT-4 46%, Gemini 35%, MedLM 14%, expert 68%.
links.quote: GPT-4 had the highest accuracy (83%) and safety (86%) scores among LLMs but remained inferior to expert responses (92% accuracy, 93% safety).

links.outcome: LLM responses compared against hypertension expert responses on same vignettes
links.effect: All three LLMs scored below the expert on accuracy and safety; GPT-4 was closest (83% vs 92% accuracy), MedLM far lower (35%).
links.quote: Despite their potential, current LLM versions are inferior to expert recommendations.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and safety of LLMs (GPT-4, Gemini, MedLM) on 51 clinical vignettes for hypertension management, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
